title: krn task works in a fresh clone before the first fetch
body:
Why: Qwen second audit .krn/runs/qwen-research-2/report.md N11: src/task/entry-pin.ts:43-49 fails closed (exit 78) when the pinned entry has never been fetched, so a fresh clone cannot run krn task.
Outcome: a missing pin on a fresh clone falls back to the working tree with one stderr warning; a pin that exists but mismatches still fails closed.
Proof: test/task entry-pin tests for the fresh-clone and mismatch cases.
